\par\vspace{3pt}
\parbox{\textwidth}{\scriptsize Protocols as in Table~\ref{tab:online} (object branch, fused). Every variant uses the same attribute rows, training subsample, two-fold cross-fitted normal reference and frame floor as the NIW row; ShT models are fitted per scene. Same components, no prior: the $k$-means components of the NIW mixture with maximum-likelihood Gaussians. ML Gaussian mixture: scikit-learn, $K$ of the NIW selection, full covariance. 1-NN: Euclidean distance to the nearest training object (FAISS, exact), on our attributes, calibration and fusion. z-score calibration: each channel standardised by the mean and standard deviation of its normal reference scores. Maximum fusion: the largest calibrated channel score. No causal median changes only the online smoothing. $^{\uparrow}$/$^{\downarrow}$ (online micro only, the pre-registered test): the 95\% paired video bootstrap interval of the difference to the NIW row (2,000 replicates, seed 0) lies above / below zero. Quarter: the five draws of Table~\ref{tab:setup}b. Scoring cost: one scene's models on ShT; the test frames with objects of the first test videos, 300 frames after 20 warm-up frames, on the shared host of Table~\ref{stab:latency}a; the attribute rows are computed beforehand for both scorers. With velocity magnitude: a fourth attribute, the sum of the eight velocity bins of an object, with its own NIW density; $^{\dagger}$suggested by test results of an earlier experiment (Section~\ref{ssec:changes}). All rows were specified before the runs.}
